title: Pre-Registered Test Cards
description: Per-bet test cards (`bets/<bet-id>/test-cards.json` in the portfolio repo, written by scripts/assumption.py — see docs/business-factory.md §2.2, chief-wiggum#236). The Camuffo-RCT-validated mechanism: the threshold block ({asm_id, metric, comparator, value, sample_min}) is content-hashed into the portfolio journal at card creation, and a verdict may only be recorded against the original hash — no post-hoc success definitions. `assumption.py rebaseline` is the only sanctioned threshold change (journaled old→new hash, --reason required). The metric must be a per-cohort rate; cumulative/gross counters are rejected as success criteria (vanity-metric lint).

asm_id.description: The assumption this card tests. Every card must resolve to a ledger ASM (dangling links are a gate finding), and every ASM needs ≥1 card (uncovered assumptions are a gate finding).

method.description: How the test runs (landing-page-smoke-test, presale, interview, concierge, …). Interview-class methods cap effective evidence strength at 1 (opinion) regardless of the declared value or the interview count — the Mom Test/Bland floor.

metric.description: The measured success criterion — a per-cohort rate (…_rate_pct, conversion, share). Cumulative/gross counters (total_*, cumulative_*, lifetime_*) are rejected by the vanity-metric lint: they falsify nothing (Ries).

threshold.description: The pre-registered pass bar. Together with asm_id/metric/sample_min this forms the threshold block content-hashed into the journal at creation.

sample_min.description: Minimum sample size for the verdict to be powered; a verdict recorded with --sample-n below this is an under-powered finding.

cost_estimate_usd.description: Estimated cost of running the test — counts against the bet envelope when spent (via `bet.py spend`).

evidence_strength.description: Fixed enum (Fitzpatrick/Bland/Savoia ladder): 1 opinion, 2 click/engagement, 3 time (scheduled session, real trial), 4 reputation (intro, public commitment), 5 money (pre-order, deposit, paid conversion). The building-transition floor requires ≥1 validated ASM at ≥4.

result.description: The measured value of `metric`, recorded with the verdict. Null until the test ran.

sample_n.description: Actual sample size behind the result, when recorded.

verdict.description: Recorded only against the original journaled threshold hash; drives the assumption's status. A verdict contradicting the pre-registered comparator is a gate finding.

verdict_ts.description: ISO timestamp the verdict was recorded.
